what: Urban Outfitters owns four retail brands: Urban Outfitters, the larger and steadier Anthropologie, the fast-growing Free People and its FP Movement activewear line, plus the Nuuly clothing rental service.
customers: Women and younger shoppers in North America and Europe, through stores, websites and rental subscriptions.
moat: Four distinct brands with their own buyers, so a fashion miss at one does not sink the company, and Anthropologie in particular has a customer who shops it for years.
risks: Fashion retail depends on getting each season right
The Urban Outfitters brand itself has been the weakest of the four for years
Free cash flow of $295M lags net income because of inventory and store investment
opportunities: 13.3 times earnings with a 7.5% net margin and $696M of cash against $1.2B of debt
Revenue grew from $4.5B to $6.2B in four years
Nuuly has become profitable and is growing quickly, which few rental businesses manage
watch: Comparable sales by brand, especially Anthropologie and Free People.
